full_page.content:
1946, April 2 Page Two
Fr. M. E. Joachim
I was going to say, when we think of past blessings and merciful providence -- notwithstand- ing our sins -- whereby God has blessed us, why should we not foster confidence by thanking Him for the future also.
Conclusion: Simply I hope you get a kind of "kick out of this. I never intended as much, but O! what God must have ahead of us if we only leave all to His planning!
Fr. Sol.
